body:
@aymeric-giraudet Installed the new package and it works great with refinement, menus, clicking through to a Hit and then using the back button. However, I was previously sending url parameters to pre-set search and Menu and those are being cleared from the URL and not applied to the InstantSearch state. Any suggestions on how to tackle pre-defined url parameters?

Steps to issue:

* User is on a listing of categories
* Clicks a category (which is a `next/link` setting `pathname` and `query`) and is sent to the InstantSearch component with url = http://localhost:3000/search?document\_search%5Bmenu%5D%5Bdomain%5D=Cloud+Security
* URL query parameters are cleared and not applied
* Previously, with just `routing={true}`, the URL parameters passed were respected and triggered a search
